description: This file is a shell script used for testing Git pull functionalities, including scenarios with rebasing, fast-forwards, autostash behavior, handling of unmerged files, and various configurations. It contains setup routines, test cases with expected outcomes, and helper functions for manipulating files and Git repositories.

methods.name: modify
methods.description: A helper function that applies a sed expression to modify a file by creating a temporary file and replacing the original.

methods.name: test_pull_autostash
methods.description: A test routine that performs a git pull with autostash enabled, checking behavior with a dirty working directory.

methods.name: test_pull_autostash_fail
methods.description: A test routine that expects a git pull with autostash to fail when uncommitted changes are present.
